q: Which element best marks up the main navigation links of a page?
t: nav is a landmark that tells browsers and screen readers this block holds main navigation.

q: What is the purpose of the alt attribute on an img tag?
c: It describes the image for screen readers and when it fails to load
w: It sets a hover tooltip only
It links the image to another page
t: alt gives a text alternative. It helps accessibility and shows when the image cannot load.

q: Which input type validates that the value looks like an email address?
t: type="email" gives built-in validation and an email-friendly keyboard on phones.

q: How do you connect a label to its input so clicking the label focuses the input?
c: Use for on the label that matches the input id
w: Use the name attribute on the label
t: label for="email" with input id="email" links them and helps screen readers announce the field.

q: Which tag is the semantic way to mark the main heading of the page?
t: h1 is the top-level heading. title goes in the head and sets the browser tab text.

q: Which heading order makes a good outline?
c: h1, then h2, then h3 without skipping levels
w: h6 first because it is smallest
t: Headings form an outline. Skipping levels confuses assistive technology users.

q: What does the viewport meta tag do?
c: Controls how the page scales on mobile screens
t: meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" makes layouts use the real screen width on phones.

q: Which is the safe way to open a link in a new tab?
t: noopener stops the new page from controlling the old one through window.opener.

q: What is the difference between b and strong?
c: strong means important, b only makes text bold
w: b means important, strong is only visual
t: strong carries meaning (importance). b is purely stylistic.

q: Which element holds a self-contained piece, like a blog post, that makes sense on its own?
t: article is for independent content such as a post, comment or news item.

q: What does <!DOCTYPE html> do?
c: Tells the browser to use standards mode
t: Without it, browsers may use quirks mode and render pages in old, inconsistent ways.

q: How do you set the page language for screen readers and translation tools?
c: Add lang to the html element
w: Add dir to the html element
t: html lang="en" helps screen readers pronounce words correctly and helps browsers offer translation.

q: What does the meta charset UTF-8 tag do?
c: Lets the browser read a wide range of characters correctly
t: UTF-8 supports almost all languages and symbols. Without it you may see broken characters.

q: Which element wraps the header rows of a table?
t: thead groups header rows, tbody the body rows and tfoot the footer rows. th is a single header cell.

q: Which element should you use for an action that does not navigate to a new page?
t: button is keyboard-focusable and announced correctly by default. Use links for navigation.

q: What does the required attribute do on an input?
c: Blocks form submission until the field has a value
t: It uses built-in browser validation. Always validate on the server too.

q: Which attribute tells the browser to delay loading offscreen images?
t: loading="lazy" loads images when they get close to the viewport, saving data.

q: What is srcset on an img tag for?
c: Letting the browser choose an image size that fits the screen
t: srcset offers several files so phones do not download huge desktop images.

q: Which pair of elements groups an image with its caption?
t: figure and figcaption link a visual with its caption semantically.

q: What is wrong with ?
c: Interactive elements should not be nested inside each other
t: Nesting interactive elements is invalid and creates confusing keyboard and screen reader behavior.

q: Which attribute hides purely decorative content from screen readers?
t: aria-hidden removes an element from the accessibility tree. Never use it on focusable elements.

q: What is the difference between id and class?
c: An id must be unique on a page, a class can be reused
w: A class must be unique, an id can be reused
t: Use id for one-of-a-kind hooks and class for repeated styling.

q: Which pair groups related form controls with a caption for accessibility?
t: fieldset and legend give related controls, like radio buttons, an accessible group name.

q: Radio buttons belong to the same group when they share...
t: Only one radio with the same name can be selected at a time.

q: What does the defer attribute do on a script in the head?
c: Downloads in parallel and runs after the HTML is parsed
w: Runs the script before any HTML
t: defer scripts run in order after parsing. async scripts run as soon as they download, in any order.

q: Which is the correct HTML comment?
t: HTML uses <!-- -->. The others belong to JavaScript, CSS or other languages.

q: Which element is for content related to the main content, like a sidebar?
t: aside marks side content such as related links or notes.

q: How many visible main elements should a page normally have?
t: main identifies the dominant content of the page. Only one visible main is allowed.

q: Which pair creates a drop-down list?
t: select with option elements creates a drop-down control.

q: What does meta name="description" influence?
c: The summary search engines may show under your page title
t: It is not a ranking guarantee, but a good description can improve clicks from search results.

q: What is the correct way to make a phone number tappable on mobile?
t: The tel: scheme asks a phone to start a call.

q: Which statement about the placeholder attribute is true?
c: It is not a replacement for a label
w: It is submitted with the form
t: Placeholders disappear and often have low contrast. Always use a real label.

q: Which input attribute checks a value against a regular expression?
t: pattern uses a regular expression for built-in validation.

q: What happens if you forget the closing tag of a p element in HTML5?
c: The browser usually closes it when the next block element starts
t: Browsers are forgiving, but clean, valid HTML avoids surprises.

q: Which element lets you offer different image files for different formats or screen sizes?
t: picture with source elements lets the browser pick the best image or format.

q: What is the noscript element for?
c: Content shown when JavaScript is disabled
w: Marking code that must not run
t: Use it to give a fallback message or content when scripts cannot run.

q: A button inside a form should not submit it. Which attribute do you use?
t: Buttons in forms default to type="submit". Set type="button" for other actions.

q: What does the autocomplete attribute help with?
c: Lets browsers fill in known values such as name or email
t: Correct autocomplete values improve usability and accessibility.

q: Which markup embeds a video with playback controls?
t: video supports built-in controls, captions with track, and multiple sources.

q: Which is the best link text?
t: Descriptive link text helps screen reader users who jump between links, and it helps SEO.
